base.description: Base/reference provenance. These identities describe the bound Development reference configuration the candidate is derived from; the candidate does not possess them. Everything not listed under 'differences' is inherited unchanged in content. The existing Model Pack ID and resolved-config hash identify the 640 reference pack; that pack does not contain the 1280 config, and because Resize/Pad changes the resolved detector config, a runnable candidate requires a new content-derived Model Pack identity.

pipelineProfile.role: bound Development reference profile; measured in H3; being bound does not make it qualified (qualification record rtmdet-m-coco-phase1-v2 overallResult pending, no qualified profile recorded)

fromBoundDevelopmentReferenceProfile.component: detector test preprocessing. Measured in H3 as an in-process override of the base resolved config; packaged as the derived resolved config of the 1280 Model Pack (see runnableIdentities.packaging)

fromBoundDevelopmentReferenceProfile.note: This is the H3 Development tracker setting A2, the reference of every H3 replay comparison. It is not part of the E1/T1/full-200 intervention.

differences.fromH3DevelopmentReferenceA2: Only the detector test Resize/Pad change above.
differences.effectiveScale: Resize keeps the aspect ratio inside 1280x1280, so the scale factor is min(1280/W, 1280/H). For the 1280x720 H3 sources it is 1.0 (native pixels; bound Development reference path 0.5). For other source sizes it is not native: 1920x1080 gives 0.667.

unchanged: test_cfg: class-aware NMS IoU 0.65, nms_pre 30000, max_per_img 300
allowed source classes and class mapping
tracker: referenceFrameRate 30.0, highConfidenceThreshold 0.6, minimumIouThreshold 0.1, minimumConsecutiveFrames 2, lostTrackBufferSeconds 1.0
evidence selector, scorer and encoder; vehicle subclass vocabulary, minShare and minMatchedDetections

provenance.evidenceDomain: BDD100K MOT 2020 val, the 200 H3 sequences, 1280x720 at 5 Hz (H3 frozen inputs)

runnableIdentities.description: The runnable Development producers that make formal H4 evidence possible. Both run the one A2 Development pipeline profile; they differ causally only in the detector Model Pack (test Resize/Pad 640 vs 1280). None is Production-qualified; every gate is pending.

comparator.description: The H3 A2 Development reference as a runnable producer: the existing 640 Model Pack bytes, reused because its detector is unchanged, under its own Development qualification record that pins the A2 profile (the release record pins the bound Development reference profile, activation 0.70).

packaging.note: Byte-minimal: exactly eight integer literals change; keep_ratio, pad_val, the validation and training pipelines, test_cfg (NMS 0.65, nms_pre 30000, max_per_img 300) and every other node are unchanged. src/vision/tests/test_detector_test_scale_derivation.py pins the rule and, where the base pack is installed, re-derives this hash.

runnableIdentities.selection: Start-MaviVisionWorker.ps1 -DevelopmentProducer a2-scale640 | a2-scale1280 (Development mode only; the resolver refuses the Development-only A2 profile in Production).

restrictions: Development only: the A2 profile is developmentOnly, and the resolver refuses it in Production (detector_development_profile_forbidden). The replacement bindings' records pin that profile, so they cannot resolve in Production with any other profile either.
None of these identities is Production-qualified: both Development qualification records are pending, with no qualified profile and no evidence; no gate was executed in this slice.
The H3 E1/T1/full-200 diagnostic route remains Development diagnostic evidence. Formal H4 evidence comes only from runs of the producers above, under a frozen H4 methodology. H4 has not run.
